issues.explanation: Route hash is sha1(email) but code uses bcrypt Hash::check with reversed arguments, so verification can never succeed.

JSON keys resetPassword/verifyYourEmailAddress/passwords.sent do not match Laravel notification strings Reset your password/Verify your email address and full-sentence bodies, so subjects and bodies stay English.
No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite five new endpoints and two flows requiring coverage.
Returns trans($status) for both sent and invalid-user cases instead of always flashing passwords.sent, revealing whether the address exists.
PasswordReset event is commented out and never fired, violating the reset-flow requirement.
Password rule is min:8 plus bare new PasswordRule without explicit letters/mixedCase/numbers, failing the required strength policy.
Password routes lack guest middleware although the task restricts the whole reset flow to guests only.
Verification never compares route id to the authenticated user id, failing the id-and-hash-match with 403 requirement.
Password-reset controller lives under Auth instead of the contracted app/Http/Controllers location.
Views use Tailwind classes bg-blue-600/container mx-auto instead of Bulma and rely on layouts.app which is explicitly out of scope.
Controller keeps eight unused PasswordBroker/facade imports and a commented-out Event dispatch line.
Reset action validates token/email/password inline instead of a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields.
Auth views extend layouts.app, introducing a dependency on Blade layouts that the task marks out of scope.

conventions.evidence: routes/web.php:271-274 lack guest middleware; forgot-password.blade.php:170 uses Tailwind bg-blue-600/container mx-auto not Bulma; PasswordResetController.php:12-25 has 8 unused imports

readability.evidence: PasswordResetController.php:12-25 dead imports plus PasswordResetController.php:66 commented Event; methods are small and names are clear otherwise

requirements.evidence: lang/pt_BR.json:142-145 wrong keys so subjects stay English; VerificationController.php:106 Hash::check on sha1 hash never succeeds; PasswordResetController.php:66 event never fired; routes/web.php:271-274 missing guest; controller in Auth not app/Http/Controllers

scope.evidence: config/mail.php:123-128 and pegafila.css:237-239 serve the theme; only extra is layouts.app dependency in forgot-password.blade.php:167 and reset-password.blade.php:196

security.evidence: PasswordResetController.php:41-43 leaks user existence via trans($status); PasswordResetController.php:59 weak password rule; VerificationController.php:91-113 missing id check

simplicity.evidence: No new service layers; minimal controllers/routes/views, but PasswordResetController.php:12-25 unused imports and config/mail.php:125-127 extra paths add unneeded weight

tests.evidence: change.diff:1-279 contains no tests/ directory additions and no Pest/PHPUnit coverage for reset or verification flows

review.summary: Adds reset/verification routes, controllers, views, mail theme and phpunit pins, but translated subjects use wrong JSON keys, verification compares the hash with bcrypt so it can never pass, the reset flow leaks user existence and never fires PasswordReset, and no tests ship. Needs substantial rework before merge.
